title: Implement and ship the frozen mitosis testing-architecture SPEC

completion_criteria.text: M1: run-store gains recordDispatch persisting each dispatch's structured response to dispatches.jsonl, with the four preserved 2026-08-21 scratch directories copied into the repository first.
M2: cassette.mjs exports loadCassette, scriptFor and CASSETTE_SCHEMA, rejecting all five invalid shapes named in the SPEC including a recorded cassette carrying a null sourceRun.
M3: buildStubDispatch takes a cassette argument; unset leaves smoke byte-identical to trunk, a two-reject cassette yields three plan-review dispatches, and exhaustion emits cassette-exhausted.
M4: all ten state and transition scenarios run from full-e2e-sweep.sh with per-scenario exit codes, and row 8, the built unit dropped on resume, is proven red on the parent and green after.
M5: the prompt side-effect harness executes every shell command the implement prompt instructs inside a trailing-slash gitignore fixture, and is confirmed red at 05b29b5e before being called correct.
M6: every mitosis test file carries a bucket and a reason; a decoration file is deleted only where its behaviour is covered elsewhere, and each withheld deletion is filed with the coverage it holds.
Green the trunk and land the stranded sweep: the two census guards main fails are fixed and pull request 277's swallowed content is cherry-picked forward, in one pull request against main.
M7: each of the five named failure branches carries a test that reddens when that branch is deleted, with the assertion quoted, or is filed as an explicit gap naming the branch.
Make the recorder see the planning phase: PR 279 merges, the primary checkout fast-forwards past it, and recordDispatch is confirmed present in the live run-store.mjs before any money is spent.
M8: one billed single-lane run harvests cassettes with provenance recorded and a sourceRun, and the M4 sweep re-runs against them with any outcome difference reported as a finding.

closure_statement: All ten criteria are met and the last pull request's content is confirmed on the trunk. Pull request 280 merged as squash commit 2d0cfa34, which is origin/main's tip; arrival was proven by tree comparison rather than by ancestry, since a squash rewrites the head sha, and rather than by the merged label. The eight-MSP testing-architecture SPEC is fully shipped: the dispatch recorder, the cassette schema and loader, the cassette-driven stub, the ten-scenario state sweep, the prompt side-effect harness, the test-file classification, the failure-branch coverage, and one billed harvest that produced two real findings. The instrument now exists, and it immediately showed that the authored scenario set has a coverage hole exactly where real reviewer behaviour landed. What the instrument does NOT yet show is a working engine: the billed lane stopped at review pass, opened no pull request, and the substrate repository carries zero pull requests, so the parent's c45 stays open and unproven. Three items sit above this thread's ceiling and are filed as new work rather than folded in: a scenario for approval on the last allowed revision, the harness built-wait race, and the four dispatch kinds that carry no unit. Two trunk defects surfaced at close and are dispatched on a successor thread, not here.

spine.active_goal: Closed. All eight MSPs of the frozen testing-architecture SPEC shipped, and pull request 280's content is confirmed on the trunk by tree comparison rather than by its merged label.
spine.next_step: Nothing here. Work continues on the successor thread covering the trunk-greening pass: the gitleaks runKey false positive, the implement-prompt node_modules artifact, making the test job a required check, and the absent MITOSIS_LIVE_GH_TOKEN. The parent thread's c45, a live run reaching a merged trunk, is the front after that and is still unproven.
spine.last_session: 2026-08-22: verified pull request 280 landed by tree comparison, since a squash makes the head sha fail ancestry. Fast-forwarded the primary checkout. Found the merge went in over two red checks, one of them a new scanner false positive recorded as 0676.

open_risks.text: Read pull request 280's checks yourself before merging — the test job is not a required status check here, so a red pull request merges on a single click
Treat a fast enforcer pass on pull request 280 as the gate declining to referee — a diff carrying no source short-circuits it and the mutation gate never runs
Pin the engine root to the primary checkout on every sweep run — the driver defaults to a linked worktree, which censuses an empty set and passes vacuously
Leave the engine root unset when running a billed lane — its default is the primary checkout, and pointing it at a worktree is why the previous billed run recorded nothing
Nine of the ten sweep scenarios still replay hand-authored responses and prove nothing about real model behaviour — only one unit was ever recorded
The recorded set is not a census of every dispatch — four dispatch kinds carry no unit and are never recorded at all

Read this suite's verdict from CI rather than any local run — the primary checkout is the only honest local reader, a fresh clone adds fourteen false failures, and a linked worktree censuses an empty set
Leave the test job off the required checks until the node_modules trailing-slash defect is fixed — it is genuinely red on main today, so requiring it would block every pull request
Treat teardown's unbounded directory removal as live — it deleted a directory outside the repository and returned success, and three call sites still reach it including the one wired as a port

key_decisions.title: The always-succeeding stub became the specification, so a green suite says nothing about live
The SPEC is frozen: implement and ship all eight MSPs before proposing anything else
A built unit is dropped on resume, the defect M4 row 8 must fix
The run-4 dropped unit is an Integrate-to-Ship defect, not a resume defect
The closed dispatch-kind set is twelve, and scope-fence is not one of them
Two decoration deletions are withheld because they are the only bar on a billed spawn
A merge swallowed by a live base branch is recovered by cherry-pick, never by merging that branch
A local green counts only when produced where the guards can see the files
The remaining work closes the instrument and stops; no further discovery rounds
The recorder is fixed to see the planning phase before M8 spends money
M7 ships as an evidence document and changes no repository file
The M8 billed run proceeds without fixing the late crash-resume kill
Recorded cassettes fold onto the four kinds the replayer can actually route
No authored scenario describes what the real reviewer did
The scanner hit on the recorded run is a false positive, suppressed by shape and never by path

out_of_scope: Changing what the planner or reviewer models are asked to do; the first-plan rejection rate is an observation, not a defect fixed here
The bypass of the dependency-injection seam in the publish path, named as a limit of the sweep rather than repaired
Any engine change not required to make a failure observable
